title: Warehouse Admin Officer

reasons.love: Role is far from the tracks he wants (e.g. engineering or pure audit).
reasons.good_at: The JD asks for sales quota experience that facts.md does not evidence.
reasons.needs: Small team with no visible training or growth path.
reasons.paid: THB 15,000-18,000 per month stated in the posting -> about THB 16,500/month.

summary: Weak on pay and growth compared with the graduate programmes on the board.
jd_text: Example Logistics Co. is hiring for Warehouse Admin Officer in Chonburi, Thailand. You will work with cross-functional teams, analyse sales and customer data, prepare weekly reports and present recommendations to managers. Requirements: bachelor's degree in any field (2026-2027 graduates welcome); good command of English and Thai; strong Excel; a team player who learns quickly. We offer structured training, mentoring and a clear career path.
